note: Three hand-authored personas for the Cataract Diagnostic Evaluation composite engine. calculateCataractEvaluation is pure (age is derived from patient.birthDate vs clinician.assessmentDate, never the clock) and returns locsIIISeverityRight/Left ('' when no subscore is recorded, 'severe' if any of NO/NC/C/P >= 5.0, 'moderate' if any >= 3.0, else 'mild'), computedSurgicalCandidacy (max-grade over moderate LOCS / BCVA LogMAR > 0.30 -> 'consider'; severe LOCS / BCVA LogMAR >= 0.48 / severe glare impact -> 'indicated'; ANY fired flag -> 'urgent-referral'; default 'not-indicated'), finalSurgicalCandidacy (= summary.overrideSurgicalCandidacy when set, else computed), overrideReason (reported only when final differs from computed), functionalImpactScore (null only when all three sub-scores are null; otherwise a sum with nulls as 0), firedRules (LOCS right, LOCS left, then the five candidacy rules in fixed order, then R-CANDIDACY-URGENT-FLAG) and flags FOLDED into the result in detection order (competing pathology, raised IOP > 21, view obscured without dilated exam, rapid progression < 3 months with a severe eye, biometry incomplete for a surgical referral, paediatric < 16) - no priority sort. Quirks verified in source: the 6/12 test is strict (LogMAR exactly 0.30 is NOT worse than 6/12) while the 6/18 test is inclusive (0.48 IS worse than 6/18); IOP exactly 21 is not raised; the low-priority F-BIOMETRY-INCOMPLETE flag alone is enough to force computedSurgicalCandidacy to 'urgent-referral' because the override checks flags.length, not priority; a clinician override can DOWNGRADE from 'urgent-referral' and needs no reason to take effect (the reason is only echoed); acuity6_12OrBetterBothEyes is exported but never called, so 'not-indicated' does not require acuity to be recorded. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas cataract-diagnostic-evaluation --update

personas.name: Early bilateral nuclear sclerosis - monitor

Functional difficulty reading 1, driving 0, daily 1. Expect locsIIISeverityRight and Left 'mild', computedSurgicalCandidacy and finalSurgicalCandidacy 'not-indicated', overrideReason '', functionalImpactScore 2, firedRules [R-LOCS-SEVERITY-RIGHT-MILD, R-LOCS-SEVERITY-LEFT-MILD] and an empty flags array.

personas.name: Threshold values, pseudophakic fellow eye, low flag escalates then overridden
personas.description: A 74-year-old man whose left eye is pseudophakic (LOCS III not graded, severity '') and whose right eye sits on every boundary: NC exactly 3.0 (moderate), BCVA LogMAR exactly 0.30 (NOT worse than 6/12 under the strict > test), IOP exactly 21 (not raised), symptom duration 2 months with no severe eye (no rapid-progression flag). A routine surgical referral is made without biometry, so the LOW-priority F-BIOMETRY-INCOMPLETE flag fires and, because the engine escalates on flags.length rather than priority, the computed candidacy jumps to 'urgent-referral'; the optometrist overrides to 'consider' with a reason. Driving difficulty left unanswered (null counts as 0). Expect locsIIISeverityRight 'moderate', locsIIISeverityLeft '', computedSurgicalCandidacy 'urgent-referral', finalSurgicalCandidacy 'consider', overrideReason set, functionalImpactScore 3, firedRules [R-LOCS-SEVERITY-RIGHT-MODERATE, R-CANDIDACY-MODERATE-LOCS, R-CANDIDACY-URGENT-FLAG ('1 safety flag(s)')] and flags [F-BIOMETRY-INCOMPLETE-FOR-SURGICAL-PLANNING-001].

personas.name: Paediatric steroid-induced posterior subcapsular cataract - urgent, six flags
personas.description: A 14-year-old on long-term oral prednisolone for nephrotic syndrome with a two-month history of rapidly worsening right vision: right eye P 5.5 (severe), left eye NC 3.5 (moderate), BCVA right LogMAR 1.0 and left 0.40, severe glare impact, IOP 28/24 (steroid response), glaucoma suspected, right fundus view obscured with no dilated exam, urgent surgical referral without biometry, no override. Driving not applicable (null). Expect locsIIISeverityRight 'severe', locsIIISeverityLeft 'moderate', computed and final candidacy 'urgent-referral', overrideReason '', functionalImpactScore 8, eight firedRules in order [R-LOCS-SEVERITY-RIGHT-SEVERE, R-LOCS-SEVERITY-LEFT-MODERATE, R-CANDIDACY-MODERATE-LOCS, R-CANDIDACY-ACUITY-6-12, R-CANDIDACY-SEVERE-LOCS, R-CANDIDACY-ACUITY-6-18, R-CANDIDACY-GLARE-SEVERE, R-CANDIDACY-URGENT-FLAG ('6 safety flag(s)')] and six flags in detection order: F-COMPETING-PATHOLOGY-SUSPECTED-001 (glaucoma), F-RAISED-IOP-001 (right 28, left 24), F-VIEW-OBSCURED-FUNDUS-NOT-ASSESSED-001, F-RAPID-PROGRESSION-001 (2 months), F-BIOMETRY-INCOMPLETE-FOR-SURGICAL-PLANNING-001, F-PAEDIATRIC-001 (age 14 at 2026-09-01).
